remarks: This luxurious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home has been freshly painted and boasts high-end finishes throughout. Step into the expansive living spaces, including a formal dining room, office, and a bright eat-in kitchen equipped with brand new appliances and elegant granite countertops. Hardwood floors throughout. The large, finished basement is perfect for entertaining, featuring a bar, kitchenette, and a spacious family room. The master suite provides a tranquil retreat, Jacuzzi and walking closet, while the expansive backyard provides ample space for outdoor enjoyment. Terrific location and close Darien and Sono train stations. Less than an Hour to NYC. Close to I-95 and the Merrit (Rt15). Experience everything Norwalk has in store! Beaches, Boating, Fishing, SONO Mall, Nightlife, Breweries, Museums, Maritime Aquarium, Free Concerts, Festivals, Cultural Events and so much more!! This exceptional home won't last long.
